investigation_findings.reported_overshoot_explanation: The reported drawdown overshoot (5.19% vs 5.0% limit) in flawed equity occurred because the Risk Manager only rejects NEW orders upon evaluation; open positions continue until stop-loss/take-profit, leading to expected closed-candle/intrabar overshoot.
investigation_findings.critical_accounting_failure: Under TRUE realized equity, Group GROUP_A suffered a catastrophic 24.87% maximum drawdown, breaching the 5.0% circuit breaker permanently on 2024-01-05T09:00:00.000Z. The simulation only continued executing 57 subsequent trades because the cash-equity inverted sign bug injected phantom cash, falsely resetting total equity above $950.
